description: Get a one-time upload link for a file that is on YOUR machine (a PDF, image, spreadsheet, audio, archive, anything over ~3 MB), so you can put it into Dock without a public host. Returns a ready `curl` command: run it with your file path in place of `<path to your file>`; its JSON response has a `url`. Then call `upload_file` with that `url` (plus `surface_slug` and `filename`). The link accepts ONE upload of an allowed file type up to 100 MB (your plan's per-file cap still applies) and expires in 15 minutes. For a video tab use `create_video_upload` instead. Editor role required.

content_type.description: Optional MIME type, e.g. application/pdf. Must be a type Dock accepts.

filename.description: The file's name, e.g. "q3-report.pdf". Its extension sets the type unless you pass `content_type`.

name: create_file_upload
